description.content: Submit an identity document photo for ocr processing. Results will be in the form of an identity document with populated with ocr results if successful. Status will be COMPLETE_OCR if OCR was successful and no further images are required. The image can be uploaded or captured via a vendor SDK after calling get IDV token, or can be submitted directly as a fileData.
